audit.whatIsWrong: Full and content both gave Lucian levels 3, 6 and 2+ items while the whys next to them describe Feast stacks and a true-damage execute taking over.
audit.why: The mirror slice already settled this chart as Lucian, Lucian, Skill, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath; restating it from Lucian's side keeps the two directions agreeing.
audit.corrected: Rows 2-6 flipped in matched full/content pairs, ratings inverted to Lucian's perspective (8, 8, 5, 4, 3, 3, 3), diff set to FAV to match the 4/10 rating and green tone the mirror fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and first item carried generic Culling copy and a Lucian kill window.
audit.why: Feast is 80/70/60s and deals true damage scaled to health, so no defensive item answers it; his first tank item plus stacks ends Lucian's trading pattern.
audit.corrected: Both rows now belong to Cho'Gath and name Feast's cooldown and damage type.

audit.whatIsWrong: Zero cooldown-sequencing anywhere (packet defect), and Feral Scream's silence — the thing that actually kills Lucian — was never tied to Relentless Pursuit.
audit.why: Rupture is a flat 6s at 950 range; Feral Scream is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s in a 300-range cone and silences, which locks out Relentless Pursuit and the whole Lightslinger pattern. Vorpal Spikes is 8s at rank 1 and slows off his autos.
audit.corrected: Sequencing added: sidestep Rupture, step in on Feral Scream's downtime, never trade inside 300 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization told the player to buy anti-heal early.
audit.why: Cho'Gath's only healing is Carnivore, which restores health when he KILLS a unit — Grievous Wounds does very little in this lane.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP. Trade on every CS he takes from the wrong angle.
edits.after: Rupture is only a 6s cooldown and Feral Scream silences your exit — poke, but never stand in his 300-range cone.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Rupture (Knockup) — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Feast HP stacks and your double-shot edge thins — trade in the seconds after Rupture misses, never inside scream range.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Feast (80s) is true damage scaled to health — Culling chip cannot race an execute that ignores armour.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: His first tank item plus Feast stacks out-scale your fragile build — take the plates and the tower, not the duel.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: He out-tanks you and Feast ignores resistances — stop sidelaning into him, play with the team and burst his divers.

edits.before: Telegraphed knockup — sidestep it and he has no engage at all. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Rupture is telegraphed and only 6 seconds — sidestep it, then step in before Feral Scream (11s) is back.

edits.before: That is Cho'Gath’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Feral Scream silences Relentless Pursuit — never trade inside his 300-range cone.

edits.before: Track Cho'Gath’s Rupture (Knockup): Telegraphed knockup — sidestep it and he has no engage at all. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Rupture (6s): sidestep the telegraph and Feral Scream (11s, 300 range) never lands — the silence, not the knockup, is what kills you.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. First: Kraken Slayer or Essence Reaver into Berserker's Greaves; then Navori / The Collector by lane state. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. First: Kraken Slayer or Essence Reaver into Berserker's Greaves; then Navori / The Collector by lane state. Skip anti-heal — Carnivore only pays him on kills.

notes: Chart restated from the mirror's settled version so the two directions agree, with ratings inverted. Anti-heal advice removed: Carnivore heals only on kills. No Grievous Wounds claim written for Lucian's own passive either — the _missing rule reads the ally-heal clause of Lightslinger, which is the same flag misfire the mirror slice documented.
